feature_contract.goal: Preserve complete original-game spatial SceneEffect stereo ownership in R84 by rejecting stale road and vehicle shader matrices that happen to share the same c64 shader, pose, and recent draw window.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R84 original SceneEffect c64 source-to-world classification only. Preserve existing lens C993/outer, HUD, time, shadows, SkyGlow, native FFB/input and independent R26_SAFE.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: R84 R30SpatialSceneEffectNeedsWorldRouting checked recent original c64, shader and pose but never checked its original producer or SpriteNode, so a previous road/vehicle draw could be falsely classified as a current world-space SceneEffect.
trace_stages: Clr_SceneEffect game callback identifies current physical SceneEffect source
Original R23 c64 recording stores source scope, producer, SpriteNode and pose per write
R84 R30 classification verifies writer identity before world-effect versus screen-plane eye routing
subcomponents: Direct source proof for original c64 scope, producer, draw window and shader and pose epochs
Queued source proof for same original SpriteNode and epoch versus foreign reused shader matrices
Portable C++ behavior regression run as dependency of the real x64 host build
